invariants.rationale: src is directly dereferenced (src.type()) at method start, so cannot be null.
If src is of nullValue type, src.asString() returns null (used in clone construction).
If src is of stringValue type, asString() must not return null.
If src is a doubleValue, src.asDouble() provides the value and is expected to be a valid number.
If src is booleanValue, asBoolean() returns a definite boolean value.
